page.title: 形容詞とtoの穴埋め関係

analysis.summaryJa: 形容詞の後ろにto不定詞を置くと、性質・感情・準備・意志・見込み・能力などを、具体的な行為へ結び付けられる。easyやdifficultでは不定詞内の目的語が主語として前に出る関係、ready・willing・reluctantなどでは主語自身が行為者になる関係、likely・sure・liableなどでは出来事の見込みを示す関係を区別する。また、行為者をfor＋人で示す評価と、人柄をof＋人で評価する形、too ... toとenough toの程度表現も扱う。
grammarPoints: easy・difficult・hard・toughなどの後ろのto不定詞が、主語について『～しやすい／しにくい』と説明すること
ready・eager・willing・reluctantなどが主語の準備・意欲・ためらいをto不定詞で示すこと
glad・sorry・surprisedなどが感情の原因となる行為をto不定詞で示すこと
likely・sure・certain・liable・aptなどが行為や出来事の見込みを示すこと
able to doが能力、too ... to doと形容詞＋enough to doが程度と可能性を示すこと
事柄の評価ではfor＋人＋to do、人柄の評価ではof＋人＋to doを選ぶこと
visualEvidence: 形容詞カードからTOの矢印が具体的な行為へ伸び、形容詞だけでは未完成の意味を補う構図
EASY・DIFFICULTの箱では、前の名詞と不定詞内の空所が点線で結ばれ、目的語関係が示されている
READY・EAGER・WILLING・RELUCTANTの人物アイコンが、それぞれ未来の行為へ向く姿勢を示している
LIKELY・SURE・LIABLEの標識が確率・見込みの違いを示し、TOの先に出来事が置かれている
FORとOFの分岐、TOOの壁、ENOUGHの通過ゲートが、行為者・人柄・程度の違いを可視化している
commonTraps: 形容詞の後ろでtoの次に過去形や-ing形を置く
easy to completeの主語がcompleteの目的語になる関係を見落とし、不要なitを加える
likelyを人の意志、willingを客観的な確率として取り違える
事柄の難易度をof＋人で、人柄の評価をfor＋人で示す
enoughを形容詞の前へ置く、またはtoo ... toを肯定可能の意味に読む
liable・aptの好ましくない傾向や起こりやすさを、単なる能力と混同する

questions.prompt: This registration form is easy ------- online.

choices.A: completing it
choices.B: to completed

questions.translationJa: この登録用紙はオンラインで簡単に記入できます。
questions.explanationJa: easyの後ろではto＋動詞原形を置き、formがcompleteの意味上の目的語になります。itを重ねません。

questions.prompt: The maintenance crew is ready ------- the inspection.

choices.A: to begin
choices.B: beginning

questions.translationJa: 保守班は点検を始める準備ができています。
questions.explanationJa: readyは主語の準備が整っていることをready to beginで表します。

questions.prompt: Ms. Patel was reluctant ------- the unverified figures.

choices.A: publishing
choices.B: published

questions.translationJa: パテルさんは未確認の数値を公表することに気が進みませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: reluctantの後ろにはto不定詞を置き、ためらいの対象となる行為を示します。

questions.prompt: The delivery is likely ------- because of the storm.

choices.A: being delayed
choices.B: to be delayed

questions.translationJa: その配送は嵐のため遅れる可能性が高いです。
questions.explanationJa: 客観的な見込みはbe likely to doで表し、配送は遅らされる側なので受動形to be delayedです。

questions.prompt: We were glad ------- that the client approved the design.

choices.A: to hear
choices.B: hearing as a habit

questions.translationJa: 顧客が設計を承認したと聞き、私たちはうれしく思いました。
questions.explanationJa: 感情の原因となった出来事をglad to hearで示します。

questions.prompt: It is essential for every driver ------- the daily log.

choices.A: signing
choices.B: signed

questions.translationJa: すべての運転手が日報に署名することが不可欠です。
questions.explanationJa: 事柄の必要性を評価し、行為者をfor every driverで示してto signを続けます。

questions.prompt: The technician was kind enough ------- the setup twice.

choices.A: explaining
choices.B: to explain

questions.translationJa: 技術者は親切にも設定方法を二度説明してくれました。
questions.explanationJa: 形容詞＋enough＋to doで、その行為をするのに十分な性質・程度を表します。

questions.prompt: The old lift is liable ------- during peak hours.

choices.A: breaking down now as a noun
choices.B: to broke down

questions.translationJa: その古いエレベーターは混雑時に故障しがちです。
questions.explanationJa: liable to doは、好ましくないことが起こりやすい傾向を示します。

questions.prompt: The revised instructions are clear enough for new staff -------.

choices.A: following
choices.B: followed

questions.translationJa: 改訂された手順は新人でも従えるほど明確です。
questions.explanationJa: clear enough for new staff to followで、行為者と可能な程度を示します。instructionsがfollowの目的語です。

questions.prompt: The applicant was too inexperienced ------- the machine alone.

choices.A: to operate
choices.B: operating successfully

questions.translationJa: 応募者は経験が浅すぎて、その機械を一人で操作できませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: too＋形容詞＋to doは、程度が過大で行為を実行できないことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an online guide.

choices.A: The online guide is simple to use it.
choices.B: The online guide is simple to use.
choices.C: The online guide is simple using.
choices.D: The online guide is simple to used.

questions.translationJa: そのオンライン案内は使いやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: guideはuseの意味上の目的語なのでsimple to useとし、itを重ねません。
questions.focus: 形容詞＋to不定詞の目的語関係

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about employee willingness.

choices.A: Several employees are willing working Saturday.
choices.B: Several employees willing to worked Saturday.
choices.C: Several employees are willing to working Saturday.
choices.D: Several employees are willing to work Saturday.

questions.translationJa: 数人の従業員は土曜日に働く意思があります。
questions.explanationJa: willing to workで主語の意思を表し、toの後ろは動詞原形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a difficult calculation.

choices.A: This estimate is difficult to verify without the source data.
choices.B: This estimate is difficult to verify it without the source data.
choices.C: This estimate is difficult verifying without the source data.
choices.D: This estimate is difficult to verified without the source data.

questions.translationJa: この見積もりは元データなしでは検証しにくいです。
questions.explanationJa: estimateがverifyの目的語になるため、to verifyの後ろにitは置きません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a favorable response.

choices.A: We were pleased receiving your confirmation as the required adjective pattern.
choices.B: We were pleased to received your confirmation.
choices.C: We were pleased to receive your confirmation.
choices.D: We pleased were to receiving your confirmation.

questions.translationJa: ご確認を受け取り、私たちはうれしく思いました。
questions.explanationJa: 感情の原因はpleased to receiveで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a forecast.

choices.A: Demand is likely increasing during the holiday season in this pattern.
choices.B: Demand likely to increases during the holiday season.
choices.C: Demand is likely to increased during the holiday season.
choices.D: Demand is likely to increase during the holiday season.

questions.translationJa: 休暇シーズンには需要が増える可能性が高いです。
questions.explanationJa: be likely to increaseが客観的な見込みを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a person's consideration.

choices.A: It was thoughtful for Ms. Reed to send a detailed map.
choices.B: It was thoughtful of Ms. Reed to send a detailed map.
choices.C: It was thoughtful of Ms. Reed sending a detailed map.
choices.D: It thoughtful was of Ms. Reed to sent a detailed map.

questions.translationJa: 詳しい地図を送ってくれたリードさんは思いやりがありました。
questions.explanationJa: thoughtfulは人柄を評価する形容詞なのでof＋人＋to doを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about task difficulty.

choices.A: It is difficult for one clerk to answer every call.
choices.B: It is difficult of one clerk to answer every call.
choices.C: It is difficult for one clerk answering every call.
choices.D: It is difficult for one clerk to answers every call.

questions.translationJa: 一人の担当者がすべての電話に応じるのは困難です。
questions.explanationJa: 行為そのものの難易度を評価するためfor＋人＋to doを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about readiness.

choices.A: The backup server is ready taking over.
choices.B: The backup server ready is to took over.
choices.C: The backup server is ready to take over.
choices.D: The backup server is ready to taking over.

questions.translationJa: 予備サーバーは引き継ぐ準備ができています。
questions.explanationJa: ready to take overが準備完了を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about excessive size.

choices.A: The package is large too to fit in the locker.
choices.B: The package is too large to fit in the locker.
choices.C: The package is too large fitting in the locker.
choices.D: The package is too large to fitted in the locker.

questions.translationJa: 荷物は大きすぎてロッカーに入りません。
questions.explanationJa: too large to fitが不可能になる程度を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a probable error.

choices.A: This shortcut is apt causing mistakes.
choices.B: This shortcut apt to caused mistakes.
choices.C: This shortcut is apt to causing mistakes.
choices.D: This shortcut is apt to cause mistakes.

questions.translationJa: この近道の手順は間違いを招きがちです。
questions.explanationJa: be apt to causeで起こりやすい傾向を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "This software is easy to install."

choices.A: This software installs another program.
choices.B: The software is impossible to install.
choices.C: The software has already been removed.
choices.D: Installing this software does not require much effort.

questions.translationJa: このソフトウェアのインストールにはあまり手間がかかりません。
questions.explanationJa: easy to installは、softwareをinstallすることが容易だという意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The team is eager to present its proposal."

choices.A: The team has refused to prepare a proposal.
choices.B: The team strongly wants to present its proposal.
choices.C: The proposal is presenting the team.
choices.D: The presentation was canceled long ago.

questions.translationJa: チームは提案を発表したいと強く望んでいます。
questions.explanationJa: eager to doは、その行為をぜひしたいという強い意欲を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The train is likely to be crowded."

choices.A: The train is required to carry no passengers.
choices.B: The train is willing to become crowded.
choices.C: The train will probably have many passengers.
choices.D: The train was certainly empty yesterday.

questions.translationJa: その列車は混雑する可能性が高いです。
questions.explanationJa: likely to be crowdedは客観的な見込みを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "It was generous of Mr. Wu to donate the equipment."

choices.A: Mr. Wu showed generosity by donating the equipment.
choices.B: Donating the equipment was difficult for Mr. Wu.
choices.D: Mr. Wu was unable to donate anything.

questions.translationJa: ウーさんは機器を寄贈するという寛大さを示しました。
questions.explanationJa: generous of Mr. Wuは、行為を通じて本人の性質を評価しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "It is unusual for this store to close early."

choices.A: The store's staff are rude to close early.
choices.B: This store does not normally close early.
choices.C: The store always closes before noon.
choices.D: Closing time is not related to the store.

questions.translationJa: この店が早く閉まるのは普段と違います。
questions.explanationJa: unusual for this store to closeは、出来事の珍しさを評価しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The room is large enough to seat fifty people."

choices.A: The room is too small for any meeting.
choices.B: Fifty people must enlarge the room.
choices.C: The room is likely to close.
choices.D: The room has sufficient space for fifty people.

questions.translationJa: その部屋には50人が座れる十分な広さがあります。
questions.explanationJa: large enough to seatは、行為が可能になる十分な程度を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The document is too confidential to circulate."

choices.A: The document is confidential enough to circulate freely.
choices.B: The document circulates itself.
choices.C: The document cannot be circulated because it is highly confidential.
choices.D: The document is easy to publish.

questions.translationJa: その文書は機密性が高すぎて回覧できません。
questions.explanationJa: too confidential to circulateは、程度が高すぎて行為が不可能だという意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "Lena is able to resolve the issue."

choices.A: Lena has the ability to resolve the issue.
choices.B: Lena is reluctant to hear about the issue.
choices.C: The issue is likely to resolve Lena.

questions.translationJa: レナにはその問題を解決する能力があります。
questions.explanationJa: be able to doは行為を実行できる能力を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "The old cable is liable to fail."

choices.A: The cable is willing to be replaced.
choices.B: The cable is certain never to fail.
choices.C: The cable has enough length for the room.
choices.D: The old cable is at risk of failing.

questions.translationJa: その古いケーブルは故障するおそれがあります。
questions.explanationJa: liable to failは、好ましくない出来事が起こりやすいことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the closest meaning: "We were surprised to see the revised price."

choices.A: We revised the price in order to surprise others.
choices.B: We expected the exact price all along.
choices.C: Seeing the revised price caused us surprise.
choices.D: The price was unable to be seen.

questions.translationJa: 改定価格を見たことが私たちの驚きの原因でした。
questions.explanationJa: surprised to seeではto不定詞が感情の原因を示します。

questions.prompt: The client wants a quick setup. Fortunately, the device is simple ------- without special tools.

choices.A: to assemble
choices.B: assembling it

questions.translationJa: 顧客は素早い設置を求めています。幸い、その装置は特殊工具なしで簡単に組み立てられます。
questions.explanationJa: deviceがassembleの目的語になるsimple to assembleの構造です。itは加えません。

questions.prompt: The inspection starts in ten minutes. The safety team is ready ------- the warehouse.

choices.A: entering
choices.B: entered

questions.translationJa: 点検は10分後に始まります。安全チームは倉庫へ入る準備ができています。
questions.explanationJa: 準備完了はready to enterで表します。

questions.prompt: No one has confirmed the rumor. The branch is unlikely ------- this month.

choices.A: closing as a noun
choices.B: to close

questions.translationJa: そのうわさは誰も確認していません。支店が今月閉鎖する可能性は低いです。
questions.explanationJa: be unlikely to closeで出来事の見込みが低いことを示します。

questions.prompt: The customer had waited an hour. It was patient of her ------- calm.

choices.A: remaining
choices.B: remained

questions.translationJa: 顧客は1時間待っていました。それでも冷静でいた彼女は辛抱強い人でした。
questions.explanationJa: patientはその人の性質を評価するためof her to remainとします。

questions.prompt: The route has several steep stairs. It may be difficult for some guests ------- the hall.

choices.A: reaching
choices.B: reached

questions.translationJa: 経路には急な階段があります。一部の来客が会場へ着くのは難しいかもしれません。
questions.explanationJa: 行為の難易度を評価するためfor some guests to reachを使います。

questions.prompt: The new analyst asked several useful questions. We were pleased ------- such careful preparation.

choices.A: to see
choices.B: seeing as a required gerund

questions.translationJa: 新任分析員は有用な質問をいくつもしました。その丁寧な準備を見て私たちはうれしく思いました。
questions.explanationJa: 感情の原因となった行為はpleased to seeで示します。

questions.prompt: The corridor is only eighty centimeters wide. It is too narrow for the cart ------- through.

choices.A: passing
choices.B: passed

questions.translationJa: 廊下の幅は80センチしかありません。台車が通るには狭すぎます。
questions.explanationJa: too narrow for the cart to passで不可能になる程度を示します。

questions.prompt: The battery was fully charged. It had enough power ------- the monitor all day.

choices.A: running
choices.B: to run

questions.translationJa: 電池は満充電でした。モニターを一日動かすのに十分な電力がありました。
questions.explanationJa: enough power to runでは名詞enough powerの後ろのto不定詞が用途・可能性を示します。

questions.prompt: The forecast shows freezing rain. Morning deliveries are liable -------.

choices.A: to be delayed
choices.B: being delayed as a present activity

questions.translationJa: 予報では凍雨です。午前の配送は遅れるおそれがあります。
questions.explanationJa: 好ましくない見込みをliable to be delayedの受動形で表します。

questions.prompt: The instructions omit one safety check. That mistake is apt ------- confusion among trainees.

choices.A: causing as a complement here
choices.B: to cause

questions.translationJa: 手順書には安全確認が一つ抜けています。その誤りは研修生の混乱を招きがちです。
questions.explanationJa: apt to causeで起こりやすい結果を示します。
